summary: Phase 2 CONTENT-IS-NAVIGATION frontend acceptance run. Onboarding (welcome-go > region-usa > interest-nhl > interests-next > onboard-search Minnesota > result-team-MINN > next > search Kaprizov > result-player-8478864 > skip) lands cleanly on the tabs shell with 1 followed player + 10 finals visible in MY HOCKEY. Acceptance journey PASSES: myhockey-player -> /player/8478864, player-team -> /team/MIN, team-next -> /game/2026010004, Game Page opponent column tap -> /team/CHI, and player<->team round-trip verified twice (Kaprizov->/team/MIN and McDavid 8478402 -> /team/EDM). Search regression 'montreal' still returns Montréal Canadiens. Static code review of the six matchup surfaces confirmed each renders a shared crest -> Team target: NhlSlate uses inline testID crest-<abbr> nested Pressables; GameRail via TappableCrest; GameDepth mini-scoreboard inline crest-<abbr>; ReelsScreen MyHockey final via TappableCrest; RecapScreen final-card via TappableCrest; TonightScreen lite-matchup via TappableCrest. ONE CLEAR MISS on the Game Page: /app/frontend/app/game/[id].tsx `<TeamCol>` is a Pressable that routes to /team/<abbr> correctly, but it does NOT carry testID=`crest-<ABBR>` as the Phase 2 spec requires ('tap the OPPONENT crest (testID crest-<ABBR>, the away/home team column)'). The tap surface itself works (visual click at 'CHI' column area navigated to /team/CHI), but automated crest-<abbr> selectors on the Game Page find 0 elements. Deprecated packages detected: none. RN Web deprecation warnings persist (shadow*, props.pointerEvents) — non-blocking, carried over from iter 26/27.

ui_bugs.issue: TeamCol Pressable is missing testID='crest-<ABBR>'. Phase 2 acceptance criteria explicitly reference this testID on the Game Page ('on Game Page tap the OPPONENT crest (testID crest-<ABBR>, the away/home team column)'). Routing works via the outer Pressable, but the identifier is absent so automated flows and any external instrumentation that looks for crest-<abbr> on the Game Page will miss.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' warning still emitted on RN web (multiple screens). Non-blocking, carry-over from iter 26/27.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx tab pane wrapper. Carry-over from iter 27.

action_items: Add testID={`crest-${abbr}`} to the away/home Pressable columns in /app/frontend/app/game/[id].tsx (the two TeamCol Pressables on lines ~106 and ~113, or add testID inside TeamCol itself). Spec-required for Phase 2 acceptance and future automation.
(Optional carry-over) Migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow and swap props.pointerEvents on the TabsHost pane wrapper to style.pointerEvents to silence RN web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: TappableCrest is a clean shared primitive: Pressable with hitSlop=8, disabled when abbr is null, testID=`crest-${abbr}`, appends ?league=<code> for non-NHL. Nested Pressable pattern relies on RN responder to give the inner press priority — code inspection confirms every matchup card places the inner Pressable BEFORE the parent's onPress bubbles, which matches Phase 2 'parent card tap must NOT swallow the individual crest taps'.

NhlSlate.tsx uses inline Pressable with testID=`crest-${abbr}` rather than TappableCrest for the sides; behavior is equivalent but this duplicates the routing logic (`router.push(`/team/${abbr}${league&&league!=='nhl'?`?league=${league}`:''}`)`). Consider consolidating to TappableCrest for a single source of truth.
GameDepth.tsx (lines 77 and 89) also uses inline Pressable + testID=`crest-${abbr}` rather than TappableCrest. Same routing logic duplication — minor DRY nit.
app/game/[id].tsx TeamCol: Pressable + onPress -> router.push(`/team/${abbr}${lq}`) works, but no testID='crest-<abbr>'. This is the one Phase 2 spec deviation surfaced by this test run.

app/player/[id].tsx line 69: player-team Pressable is correct (testID='player-team'), routes with league query when non-NHL. Player Page also renders next game and Last-5 cards that route to /game/<id>, and 3-stars/skater rows that route to /player/<id> — richly navigational per Phase 2 spirit.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (acceptance journey PASS end-to-end; 1 spec deviation on Game Page testID; 6/6 matchup crest independence code-verified; 3/3 routing hops runtime-verified; search regression PASS)

rca_of_issue: Missing testID on Game Page TeamCol: file /app/frontend/app/game/[id].tsx defines TeamCol as an internal component wrapping NhlLogo + name + score/abbr in a Pressable with onPress -> router.push, but never sets a testID on that Pressable. The Phase 2 review explicitly names 'crest-<ABBR>' on the away/home Game Page column. Fix: either add testID={`crest-${abbr}`} to the outer Pressable inside TeamCol, or set it at the call site (game/[id].tsx lines ~106 and ~113).
